facts.fact: Revises F063: the warden report of Dilan's death records blood on the ice and a scrap of skin frozen to it, torn from the rim of an ear (not cartilage), consistent with Kiran's blackened ear rim.
Rohan privately counts Meera's first lie to him: her ch 1 claim that Jassi was deaf in the left ear and had a cold in his chest, disproved when Jassi answered across the yard. He says nothing.

Revises F060: Varun lost a pewter button on the stair and wears a brand-new brass one from the quartermaster's tin of odds, among his pewter buttons; he also grumbles of a frayed cuff and chalky issue polish. It is named once in a run of gripes.

Rohan's sealed order reads 'Bring in the Salt Fox at the thaw'; he does not know why the queen wants the fox delivered rather than hanged. The order's seal has been broken once and pressed flat since.
